boxes.text: Do you or any of your branches/offices, subsidiaries or joint ventures have current or contemplated activity, directly or indirectly, in, with or involving any Sanctioned Jurisdiction? Please select "Yes" for any activity, including those activities that are not prohibited by Sanctions, or specifically authorized by a relevant sanctions authority. If "Yes" is selected, please provide further details in Part 2.

outline.text: La Banque des Entreprises WB Sanctions Questionnaire
La Banque des Entreprises, its subsidiaries and affiliates (collectively "La Banque des Entreprises") are required to comply with applicable sanctions law and regulations 1
imposed by the Netherlands, the European Union, as well as other sanctions authority of each jurisdiction where La Banque des Entreprises has operations, such as for example
the United States ("Sanctions"). As an La Banque des Entreprises client, you and your branches/offices and subsidiaries are expected to refrain from directing transactions to or
through La Banque des Entreprises and otherwise using La Banque des Entreprises products, funds, accounts or services in connection with any transaction or activity, directly or
indirectly involving individuals, entities, aircraft or vessels that are the subject of Sanctions ("Sanctioned Parties") as well as Sanctioned Jurisdictions (as defined below) or where
a transaction or activity would be prohibited for La Banque des Entreprises, and/or would result in a violation of Sanctions by La Banque des Entreprises.
This questionnaire is one of the means through which La Banque des Entreprises aims to identify the extent of our clients' activities with certain entities,
jurisdictions and territories and their direct or indirect engagements with targets of sanctions regimes. We kindly refer you to La Banque des Entreprises's
FEC statement published on our website.
Clients are required to provide information about their business activities in or with the countries (or regions as the case may be): Belarus, Crimea, Cuba,
Iran, North Korea, Russia, Sudan, Syria, or the illegally annexed regions of Zaporizhzhia, Kherson, Donetsk and Luhansk in Ukraine ("Sanctioned
Jurisdictions2") and Sanctioned Parties. In this questionnaire Sanctioned Parties shall be understood to include any individual, entity, vessel or aircraft
that is, or is owned by 50% or more or controlled (irrespective of ownership) by one or more persons that are listed on a Sanctions list or is otherwise
To enable La Banque des Entreprises to document your sanctions exposure, the Sanctions Questionnaire is requested to be completed by an appropriate and
authorised representative of your company. The responses provided should encompass and be fully applicable to and reflective of all subsidiaries, investments,
joint-ventures, branches and representative offices, incorporated and/or based anywhere in the world, which are owned, controlled and/or managed by you. For
the avoidance of doubt this would include subsidiary / subordinate entities which do not have any relationship with La Banque des Entreprises.
Please answer all questions of this document and complete the Sanctions Exposure Confirmation at the end of this document.
